column4: Via Hyron: Path of the Hive Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to ride the wave in frenzy
column7: The heart of Abel’s prized Beast was to him by the One Above. Its voice is sacred and unleashing its divinity protects his angels from assault.

column4: Via Hyron: Path of the Hive Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to staunch the influence of institutionalized religion
column7: Throughout history, the deceiver, Lucifer, has twisted faith and clothed the spread of ignorance, bigotry, delusion, greed, and mayhem in the hypocrisy of religion. It is the duty of the Molochim to shepherd Caine’s flock.

column4: Via Hyron: Path of the Hive Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Feeding on the children of Seth
column7: Reclaim Abel’s blood in vengeance from the builders, Caine’s children. Those living in harmony with Creation in the wild are not subject to retribution from the One Above.

column4: Via Hyron: Path of the Hive Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Not actively pursuing safe knowledge of sorcery and the demonic
column7: Know thy enemy. Ignorance is darkness, and darkness is where the infernal hides. Blood sorcery is the sacrament in the arsenal against atrocity.

column4: Via Hyron: Path of the Hive Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Refusing an opportunity to convert those seeking redemption
column7: The larger the hive, the greater the swarm. Those who have faced the infernal are hornets without a Nest waiting to be saved. Bind them through the blood and release them when they find shelter

column4: Via Hyron: Path of the Hive Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Refusing to sing a lullaby to the sleepers
column7: The sleepers’ dreams are fueled by havoc and devastation visited upon Creation. Without fuel, the sleepers turn their attentions away from dreaming and seek to awaken.

column4: Via Hyron: Path of the Hive Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Not being selective in a lullaby
column7: Undirected destruction that does not serve as fertilizer for new Creation to emerge is no better than an awoken sleeper. Shepherd Creation by strategic application of violence and suffering.

column4: Via Hyron: Path of the Hive Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to enslave or extinguish the demonic
column7: The One Above damned Lucifer and his children; their existence is forfeit.

column4: Via Hyron: Path of the Hive Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to cleanse the infernal
column7: Each utterance of a sleeper’s name and soul lost to the demonic stirs the sleepers from dream.

column4: Via Hyron: Path of the Hive Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to Nest
column7: Independence is the gateway to the infernal; Lucifer preys first upon individuals alone. Unity is the of the hive, isolation weakens the swarm. If leaving a Nest, find another.

column4: Path of the Scorched Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to acquire knowledge that is safely and readily available
column7: Knowledge is the wellspring of truth; you can never know enough.

column4: Path of the Scorched Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Committing to any action without purpose
column7: Do not waste effort on what does not enhance you.

column4: Path of the Scorched Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Sacrificing when you gain less
column7: A victory that costs you more than you earn garners no benefit.

column4: Path of the Scorched Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Relying on others
column7: Your actions are the only ones you can predict with absolute certainty.

column4: Path of the Scorched Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Making assumptions
column7: Without clarity, error hides in the fog of unconsidered data.

column4: Path of the Scorched Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Acting rashly
column7: You cannot learn from indiscriminate action. Observe, think, calculate, consider, then act.

column4: Path of the Scorched Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Speaking falsely
column7: Truth is a bullet. Without trust, truth has no gun.

column4: Path of the Scorched Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Falling to frenzy or Rötschreck
column7: Carelessness is dangerous. You cannot control the threats you fail to see when not objective. If you cannot master yourself, you have no defense against others mastering you.

column4: Path of the Scorched Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Making decisions based on emotion
column7: The urges of emotion are the words of the Beast, not your own. Purge them.

column4: Path of the Scorched Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Acknowledging your emotions
column7: The Beast feels. You do not. Deny the Beast and it withers.

column4: Path of Self-Focus Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Accepting everything
column7: A bowl filled to the brim will spill.

column4: Path of Self-Focus Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Accepting nothing
column7: Oversharpen your knife and it will break.

column4: Path of Self-Focus Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Laziness
column7: An ant on the move does more than a sleeping elephant.

column4: Path of Self-Focus Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Interfering in the universe
column7: In order to lead, walk behind.

column4: Path of Self-Focus Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Restraining the Beast
column7: Struggle creates conflict and moves you out of line with yourself.

column4: Path of Self-Focus Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failure to treat others as you would be treatedAct as your own master.
column7: Even a teacher must be questioned.

column4: Path of Self-Focus Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Allowing the universe to interfere with you
column7: You alone control your actions.

column4: Path of Self-Focus Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Overconfidence
column7: To know strength, harness weakness.

column4: Path of Self-Focus Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Rejecting nothing
column7: Water is gentler and more flexible than anything, and yet nothing can resist it.

column4: Path of Self-Focus Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Rejecting everything
column7: By not changing direction, you always arrive where you are headed.

column4: Hierarchy of Sins against the Asakku
column6: Using or answering to your former name
column7: You are not a vampire. You are one strand in a web of power.

column4: Hierarchy of Sins against the Asakku
column6: Refusing to use Vicissitude at every opportunity
column7: Become your power.

column4: Hierarchy of Sins against the Asakku
column6: Failing to increase your command of Vicissitude to the greatest extent possible
column7: You must apply all your efforts to identifying with the Watcher within.

column7: Take back the power they have stolen.

column4: Hierarchy of Sins against the Asakku
column6: Refusing to teach Vicissitude
column7: Let the Watcher see through a thousand eyes.

column4: Hierarchy of Sins against the Asakku
column6: Allowing enemies to discover your true haven
column7: Your lair belongs to the Watcher.

column4: Hierarchy of Sins against the Asakku
column6: Betraying another of the Corrupted
column7: We emanate from the same darkness and must claw our way into the world together.

column4: Hierarchy of Sins against the Asakku
column6: Allowing enemies to discover your true nature
column7: Let Caine’s bastards forget the origins of their gifts until we are ready to reclaim them openly.

column4: Hierarchy of Sins against the Asakku
column6: Refusing to convert those under the blood bond to the Path
column7: The Watcher requires followers to manifest more powerfully.

column4: Hierarchy of Sins against the Asakku
column6: Failing to use Vicissitude nightly, unless in torpor
column7: The murmuring shadow within must speak

column4: Path of Blood Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Breaking a word of honor to a Clanmate
column7: Solidarity is important to the Assamites’ holy cause.

column4: Path of Blood Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Refusing to offer a non-Assamite an opportunity to convert
column7: The childer of Khayyin are accursed and must be saved.

column4: Path of Blood Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Succumbing to frenzy

column4: Path of Blood Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to pursue the lore of Khayyin
column7: To oppose one’s enemies successfully, one must learn all about them.

column4: Path of Blood Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to demand blood as payment
column7: Other members of the Clan may benefit from such vitae, no matter how diluted.

column4: Path of Blood Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Refusal to aid a more advanced member of the Path
column7: To act selfishly is to fall into the snares of Khayyin’s pawn.

column4: Path of the Bones Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Showing a fear of death
column7: Fear inhibits learning.

column4: Path of the Bones Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to study an occurrence of death
column7: Refusal to learn indicates refusal to understand.

column4: Path of the Bones Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Accidental killing

column4: Path of the Bones Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Postponing feeding when hungry
column7: Denial of the self serves no greater purpose.

column4: Path of the Bones Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Succumbing to frenzy
column7: The Beast is irrational, and emotion serves little to advance understanding.

column4: Path of the Bones Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Refusing to kill when an opportunity presents itself
column7: Experimentation proves theory, and without proof, there is no conclusion.

column4: Path of the Bones Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Making a decision based on emotion rather than logic
column7: Vampires are dead; so, too, are their emotions.

column4: Path of the Bones Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Inconveniencing oneself for another’s benefit
column7: Death is inevitable; what meaning does easing another’s doomed discomfort have?

column4: Path of the Bones Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Needlessly preventing a death
column7: One must not prevent the cycle, but should learn from it.

column4: Path of the Bones Hierarchy of Sins

column7: Such emotional ties befit humans, not Kindred. EDITION 319

column4: Path of Caine Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to engage in research or study each night, regardless of circumstances
column7: The search for truth requires dedication.

column4: Path of Caine Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to instruct other vampires in the Path of Caine
column7: All vampires must have the opportunity to explore their potential.

column4: Path of Caine Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Befriending or co-existing with mortals
column7: Caine was separated from mortals, as all vampires should be.

column4: Path of Caine Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Showing disrespect to other students of Caine
column7: All of the Children of Caine deserve the respect due their heritage, as long as they strive to understand themselves.

column4: Path of Caine Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to ride the wave in frenzy
column7: Direct the Beast; do not be directed by it.

column4: Path of Caine Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Succumbing to Rötschreck
column7: Master your fear. Terror is for lesser beings.

column4: Path of Caine Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to diablerize a “humane” vampire
column7: Those who do not explore their potential forfeit that potential.

column4: Path of Caine Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to regularly test the limits of abilities and Disciplines
column7: Develop your capabilities to their limits in order to discern your true nature.

column4: Path of Caine Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to pursue lore about vampirism when the opportunity arises
column7: Every scrap of knowledge adds a piece to the puzzle of undead existence.

column4: Path of Caine Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Denying vampiric needs (by refusing to feed, showing compassion, or failing to learn about one’s vampiric abilities)
column7: To be a vampire, one must satisfy a vampire’s needs.

column4: Path of Cathari Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Exercising restraint
column7: One’s purpose is excess, not moderation.

column4: Path of Cathari Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Showing trust
column7: Use or be used.

column4: Path of Cathari Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to pass on the Curse to the passionately wicked or virtuous
column7: The depraved can serve evil better as vampires; the virtuous can be overcome by the Curse.

column4: Path of Cathari Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to ride the wave in frenzy
column7: The Beast, as well as the higher self, must be indulged.

column4: Path of Cathari Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Acting against another Albigensian
column7: Those of like purpose should fulfill that purpose, not quarrel among themselves.

column4: Path of Cathari Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Impassioned killing
column7: Murder achieves no greater end; dead men cannot sully their souls.

column4: Path of Cathari Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Sacrificing gratification for someone else’s convenience
column7: Promote physical pleasures, not altruistic achievements.

column4: Path of Cathari Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Refraining from indulgence
column7: The material world is a place for the gratification of the flesh.

column4: Path of Cathari Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Arbitrary killing
column7: Killing a mortal prevents his bringing about his own damnation.

column4: Path of Cathari Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Encouraging others to exercise restraint
column7: Vampires are creatures of evil; the vampire’s purpose is to corrupt, not save.

column4: Path of the Feral Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Hunting with means other than your own vampiric powers
column7: The perfect hunter needs no tools.

column4: Path of the Feral Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Engaging in politics
column7: Political struggles do not yield sustenance.

column4: Path of the Feral Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Remaining in the presence of fire or sunlight, except to kill an enemy
column7: There is no sense in courting Final Death.

column4: Path of the Feral Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Acting in an overly cruel manner
column7: Death is natural; feeding is natural. Torture and cruelty are not.

column4: Path of the Feral Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to hunt when hungry
column7: The vampire’s purpose is to feed.

column4: Path of the Feral Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to support your pack or allies
column7: Support your family, and it will support you.

column4: Path of the Feral Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Killing without need
column7: A dead vessel may not be fed from in the future.

column4: Path of the Feral Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to follow one’s instincts
column7: Instinct is the basis of predatory nature.

column4: Path of the Feral Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Killing a creature other than for survival
column7: A kill’s purpose is sustenance.

column4: Path of the Feral Heart Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Refusing to kill to survive
column7: Vampires are hunters; everyone else is the hunted.

column4: Path of Honorable Accord Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to uphold all the precepts of your group
column7: True duty to a cause requires sterling character.

column4: Path of Honorable Accord Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to show hospitality to your allies
column7: Hospitality and generosity are the wealth of the soul.

column4: Path of Honorable Accord Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Associating with the dishonorable
column7: Serve as an example, but do not be dragged into pettiness.

column4: Path of Honorable Accord Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to participate in your group’s rituals
column7: Tradition and ritual are important parts of heritage.

column4: Path of Honorable Accord Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Disobeying your leader
column7: Loyalty is the keystone of hierarchy.

column4: Path of Honorable Accord Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to protect your allies
column7: Defend those who are worthy of your esteem.

column4: Path of Honorable Accord Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Placing personal concerns over duty
column7: Duty is the vampire’s purpose.

column4: Path of Honorable Accord Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Showing cowardice
column7: Honor lies in fighting for a cause, not in fleeing it.

column4: Path of Honorable Accord Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Killing without reason
column7: Life and death are God’s to decree.

column4: Path of Honorable Accord Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Breaking your word or oath; failing to honor an agreement
column7: To break one’s oath is to be without the honor that defines existence.

column4: Path of Lilith Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Feeding immediately when hungry
column7: Deprivation and hunger taught Lilith to survive.

column4: Path of Lilith Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Pursuing temporal wealth or power
column7: True wealth comes from inside, not from money or influence.

column4: Path of Lilith Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Not correcting the errors of others regarding Caine and Lilith
column7: Caine was a murderer, traitor, and fool who deserves no reverence.

column4: Path of Lilith Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Feeling remorse for bringing pain to someone
column7: Pain and suffering help others to learn and grow.

column4: Path of Lilith Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to participate in a Bahari ritual
column7: The rituals handed down through time contain clues to awakening.

column4: Path of Lilith Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Fearing death
column7: Death is simply an inevitable change to a new form of existence.

column4: Path of Lilith Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Killing a living or unliving being
column7: Death denies one the chance to transcend.

column4: Path of Lilith Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Not seeking out the teachings of Lilith
column7: Lilith hid her works in many places; they must be found.

column4: Path of Lilith Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to dispense pain and anguish
column7: Be a teacher through the pain.

column4: Path of Lilith Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Shunning pain
column7: Only through pain are we reborn.To shun pain is to embrace ignorance.

column4: Path of Metamorphosis Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Postponing feeding when hungry
column7: Hunger causes distraction.

column4: Path of Metamorphosis Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Indulging in pleasure
column7: Hedonism deters one from greater ends.

column4: Path of Metamorphosis Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Asking another for knowledge
column7: The lessons of Metamorphosis are secrets that must be uncovered, not copied.

column4: Path of Metamorphosis Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Sharing knowledge with another
column7: Knowledge must be learned, not simply illustrated.

column4: Path of Metamorphosis Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Refusing to kill when knowledge may be gained from it
column7: Before transcending death, the Metamorphosist must understand it.

column4: Path of Metamorphosis Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to ride out a frenzy
column7: A Kindred must know the Beast to transcend it.

column4: Path of Metamorphosis Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Considering the needs of others
column7: Those who cannot be bothered to attain Metamorphosis are beneath one’s attention.

column4: Path of Metamorphosis Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failure to experiment, even at risk to oneself
column7: The Path can be understood only through empirical research.

column4: Path of Metamorphosis Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Neglecting to alter one’s own body
column7: Physical change must be attained before any more significant metamorphosis.

column4: Path of Metamorphosis Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Exhibiting compassion for others
column7: The fates of others drag one into devolution, not transcendence.

column4: Path of Night Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Killing a mortal for food
column7: Dead mortals feel no dread.

column4: Path of Night Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Acting in the interests of another
column7: There is no time to fulfill petty agendas.

column4: Path of Night Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to be innovative in one’s depredations
column7: Familiarity for one’s vile acts breeds contempt for them in others, and they may soon fail to shock.

column4: Path of Night Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Asking aid of another
column7: Those who cannot provide for themselves fulfill their ends poorly.

column4: Path of Night Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Accidental killing
column7: God has made Kindred horrors, not murderers.

column4: Path of Night Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Bowing to another Kindred’s will
column7: The games of the Jyhad are diversions from the Damned’s true purpose.

column4: Path of Night Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Intentional or impassioned killing
column7: Death serves no one; it merely deprives one of a victim.

column4: Path of Night Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Aiding another
column7: Compassion has no place in a vampire’s undead heart.

column4: Path of Night Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Accepting another’s claim to superiority
column7: All Kindred are equal under God’s plan.

column4: Path of Night Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Repenting one’s behavior
column7: The Kindred’s purpose is to cause repentance, not to practice it.

column4: Path of Paradox Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Embracing a woman
column7: Women should be bearers of life, not death.

column4: Path of Paradox Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Embracing outside the jati
column7: Most others fail to comprehend the depth of the Paradox philosophy.

column4: Path of Paradox Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Destroying another Shilmulo
column7: Charity does not, as is widely believed, begin at home.

column4: Path of Paradox Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Killing a mortal for sustenance
column7: Death robs a person of the ability to fulfill their svadharma.

column4: Path of Paradox Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to destroy a vampire on another Path
column7: Those who cannot see the true way should be returned to a productive role in the cycle.

column4: Path of Paradox Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Killing a mortal for reasons other than survival
column7: A person may not have achieved her svadharma, and preventing such is anathema.

column4: Path of Paradox Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failure to aid another’s svadharma
column7: The gods have set this as the Shilmulo’s purpose.

column4: Path of Paradox Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Allowing one’s Sect affairs to take precedence over one’s dharma
column7: One’s allegiance should be to the gods, not one’s companions.

column4: Path of Paradox Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Becoming blood bound
column7: One may never destroy one’s regnant, which is the whole purpose of this Path.

column4: Path of Paradox Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Embracing needlessly or out of personal desire
column7: One must return others to the cycle, not extract them from it.

column4: Path of Power and the Inner Voice Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Denying responsibility for your actions
column7: Dereliction of responsibility is a failure to lead properly.

column6: Treating your underlings poorly
column7: Reward competence as an incentive, but do so sparingly.

column4: Path of Power and the Inner Voice Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to respect your superiors
column7: Give the respect that is due, that you might learn something in turn.

column4: Path of Power and the Inner Voice Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Helping others when it is not to your advantage
column7: Always gain something from your actions.

column4: Path of Power and the Inner Voice Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Accepting defeat
column7: Succeed, or die.

column4: Path of Power and the Inner Voice Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to kill when it’s in your interests
column7: Do not hesitate to eliminate those who would stand against you.

column4: Path of Power and the Inner Voice Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Submitting to the error of others
column7: Be right and you will be vindicated. Follow a fool and you will suffer for it.

column4: Path of Power and the Inner Voice Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Not using the most effective tools for control
column7: Power must be seized. Be iron-fisted and resolute.

column4: Path of Power and the Inner Voice Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Not punishing failure
column7: Failure is instructive only when used as a negative example.

column4: Path of Power and the Inner Voice Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Turning down the opportunity for power
column7: Personal power is the means to all ends.

column4: Path of Typhon Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Pursuing one’s own indulgences instead of another’s
column7: The slide into vice is a tool, not a recreation.

column4: Path of Typhon Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Refusing to aid another follower of the Path
column7: Teams work more efficiently than individuals to raise Set.

column4: Path of Typhon Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to destroy a vampire in Golconda
column7: Those who have transcended their desires cannot brought under sway.

column4: Path of Typhon Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to observe Setite religious ritual
column7: You must not deny Set his due.

column4: Path of Typhon Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to undermine the current social order in favor of the Setites
column7: Other Kindred are purposeless or misled, and this indolence delays Set’s revival.

column4: Path of Typhon Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to do whatever is necessary to corrupt another
column7: The more individuals in the Setites’ debt, the better.

column4: Path of Typhon Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to pursue arcane knowledge
column7: The mysteries of Set’s resurrection may be hidden anywhere.

column4: Path of Typhon Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Obstructing another Setite’s efforts
column7: The ranks of the righteous are no place for petty power plays.

column4: Path of Typhon Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Failing to take advantage of another’s weakness
column7: Compassion has no place in Set’s greater plans.

column4: Path of Typhon Hierarchy of Sins
column6: Refusing to aid in Set’s resurrection
column7: This is the purview of unbelievers.

column4: HIERARCHY OF SINS AGAINST WHO YOU ARE
column6: Risking your own life
column7: Survival is paramount.

column4: HIERARCHY OF SINS AGAINST WHO YOU ARE
column6: Acknowledging a leader
column7: There is no “us”, only “me.”
